title: Family with Newborn Outside Hospital, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A multigenerational family stands proudly at the top of wide exterior stone stairs outside a collegiate Gothic or Tudor-style brick building numbered 525, likely a maternity hospital or church. An older woman holds a tightly wrapped newborn baby, accompanied by a young man in a tailored suit, an older gentleman in a dark suit holding a fedora, and a woman wearing a stylish 1940s hat and dark overcoat. The snapshot captures an intimate post-World War II family milestone, likely a christening ceremony or departing the hospital with the new baby.
